title: ainsliaea latifolia
intro: Ainsliaea latifolia, commonly known as the Chinese mountain tea or broad-leaved Ainsliaea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a shrub native to China and India, valued for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Ainsliaea latifolia include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
